digest.component_or_area: code-review project criterion dogfood and Gerrit review bot integration
propositions: The deployed Gerrit review bot must load and execute the review-phase-boundaries project criterion end-to-end through its live webhook-to-checkout-to-prompt pipeline to prove the criterion works in production, not just in offline fixtures.

Four sequential patchsets against a single Gerrit change dogfood the criterion: a positive control establishing baseline, a historical severity-only negative control documenting stimulus limits, a predeclared FIRE corpus control verifying project-attributed execution, and a final cleaned patchset with only valid instructions submitted to main.

The project-attributed advisory finding from the FIRE patchset must carry reviewer_id=code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries, criteria=[project.review-phase-boundaries], and observable Pass-2 validity/impact and Pass-3 priority/decision/threshold/posture from the persisted code_review_result_v2 artifact.

Blocking must remain disabled (blocking_enabled: false) and threshold fixed at 0.90 throughout the dogfood; any decision to enable blocking requires a separate, data-backed, separately-reviewed future ticket.
The final submitted revision must contain only phase-compliant instructions, produce no project-criterion findings, and be verifiable on origin/main with no negative directives present.

A calibration handoff comment must record the observed priority distribution and explicitly defer blocking promotion to a future separately-reviewed posture ticket backed by accumulated production review data.
